correctness.rationale: Expanded ab as six powers at 0,u,v,w,u+v,u+w. Binary carrying reduces multiset size by one per carry, so weight four needs exactly two merges. The initial equalities are precisely u=v, u=w, w=u+v. Reconstructed the exhaustive three-case proof, checking all subsequent collisions, including exceptional weight 2/3 triples (1,1,2),(1,1,3),(2,1,2),(2,2,3). Wrote an independent exhaustive verification over 252,800 exponent triples with 1≤u≤80 and 1≤v<w≤80 using Python integer bit_count; every predicted membership agreed with actual s₂(ab), with 349 weight-four triples and four low-weight exceptions. This finite test corroborates, but only the complete symbolic coincidence/carry case analysis proves the unbounded infinite families.
